Name: Namazu Flippers
Author: darrelltang
Punchline: Daily cross-server arbitrage route — flip items, make gil.
Description: Namazu Flippers connects to the Saddlebag Exchange API to find daily cross-server arbitrage opportunities. Get a route-optimized shopping list, travel between servers, buy low, sell high on your home world. One scan, one route, done in under 20 minutes.
